result.title: Hybrid Federated Learning for Multimodal Fusion under Missing Modalities and Site Heterogeneity
result.summary: Multimodal fusion is studied under hybrid federation, where data are partitioned across samples and feature blocks. The proposed two-dimensional federated smooth multiple-kernel large-margin learning method (2D-FedSMKL) integrates availability-corrected modality scores, group-kernel regularization, and smooth worst-site risk aggregation. For fixed maps and propensities, the objective is convex and smooth. Curvature bounds and exact synchronous block-gradient equivalence are established for binary and multiclass scores, giving a conditional accelerated rate. An oracle-propensity binary risk bound and a propensity-perturbation result are also derived. Simulations and two public activity-recognition benchmarks assess site heterogeneity and modality absence. Worst-site aggregation improves worst-site performance under heterogeneity, including reversed and size-balanced designs. On the benchmarks, validation selects the correction; the selected model is not significantly worse than the strongest reference at the worst site, and group-regularization benefits vary by dataset.

AI.brief_summary: 研究样本与特征块双重划分的混合联邦下多模态融合，提出 2D-FedSMKL，结合可用性校正的模态分数、组核正则与最差站点风险聚合，并给出凸性、曲率界与条件加速收敛等理论结果，在活动识别基准上考察站点异质与模态缺失。
AI.relevance_reason: 「可用性校正的模态分数」与最差站点风险聚合或可为视觉证据缺失时的融合加权与鲁棒性评价提供概念线索，但该文属联邦优化理论，与 LVR 的 latent 状态生成无直接关联，可供核查但迁移距离较远。
